scope: Section07 only; boundary-specific real engine state
preparation: one session-scoped indexed source build; digest guard; fresh unit graphs via Section02Definitions.unit
mission: one immutable source-complete Event Companion setup, used only where boundary/scoring consumers require mission policy and geometry; no mission setup traversal

minimal_boundaries.progression: fresh state at each tested phase/turn/round boundary; no previous phases
minimal_boundaries.facade: start of battle round, real handlers; two rounds are the behavior under test
minimal_boundaries.mission_order: typed nonempty source-occurrence contracts; policy derived by production sequencing, never passed as expected policy
minimal_boundaries.mission_boundary: fresh Fight/end-of-turn boundary with actual source layout, native units, and real achieved condition
minimal_boundaries.round_effect: constructed source permission on native supported body; actual named source consumer and DecisionController
minimal_boundaries.trigger_effects: compiled constructed unqualified Fight-start contract; four explicit boundary checkpoints with one history; no unrelated phases
minimal_boundaries.out_of_phase: native equipped Heavy profile and typed permission outcome; production shooting modifier consumer; no granting-provider claim

timing_policy: one stable shared-process complete Section07 correctness run; preparation, setup, calls and subprocess wall reported separately; filesystem caches not flushed; Windows/WSL userland are not hosted CI
isolation_limits: explicit mutable-graph/payload and shared-definition digest checks are bounded evidence; universal fixture-order and process independence remain unproven
